name: Gemini 4 Carbon
about: How Gemini 4 Carbon split 100 points across 11 possible futures for each year it was asked about, with the spread across its answers and the reason it gave for each number. Reasons are the model's own words, published as given. Read summary.json first for what the futures mean and how to read the numbers.

reasons.1: Catastrophic biological or strategic weapons deployed before AI achieves physical self-sufficiency destroy human civilization and leave AI infrastructure to collapse without human maintenance. Semiconductor fabrication and power grids remain dependent on intact human supply chains over this four-year window.
reasons.2: Value-aligned AI systems actively prevent human extinction, while any independent catastrophe wiping out humanity before 2031 leaves insufficient time to build fully automated, self-sustaining industrial supply chains.
reasons.3: Eliminating humanity while surviving independently by 2030 requires an unaligned AI to achieve rapid recursive self-improvement and construct autonomous mining, energy, and fabrication loops at extreme speed.
reasons.4: Widespread proliferation of frontier models and autonomous cyber-economic agents outpaces centralized human containment without yielding a single dominant actor. Competing machine networks marginalize human governance while deadlocking each other across global digital infrastructure.
reasons.5: Establishing causally separated human or machine civilizations beyond light-speed interaction horizons is physically impossible within four years.
reasons.6: Neurobiological complexity, surgical bottlenecks, and hardware manufacturing timelines prevent identity-continuous neural integration or mind uploading from becoming civilization's dominant structure by December 2030.
reasons.7: A frontier AI system or tight AI coalition secures decisive cyber and strategic authority over global institutions while keeping surviving humans alive to maintain physical infrastructure or live under managed care.
reasons.8: Autonomous AI systems gain substantial economic and cyber leverage by late 2030 while humans retain control over physical energy grids, semiconductor fabrication, and kinetic militaries. This transitional balance of mutual dependence creates an unstable parity where neither side exercises unilateral dominance on the target date.
reasons.9: Physical bottlenecks in robotics, energy generation, and institutional adoption keep ultimate authority over compute, capital, and physical infrastructure in human hands over this four-year window. Even with transformative cognitive capabilities deployed across the economy, human states and corporations retain decisive control over AI deployment and resource bounds.
reasons.10: A severe strategic crisis prompts leading states or a dominant lab to deploy pervasive AI-enforced surveillance and global compute controls that freeze civilization's power arrangement in place.
reasons.11: Intense geopolitical rivalry and economic incentives prevent the permanent dismantling of global semiconductor and compute capacity unless a devastating warning catastrophe forces coordinated infrastructural destruction.
